rows.en: welcome back to the workshop where we turn raw footage into finished films
rows.zh: 欢迎回到工作坊，我们在这里把原始素材变成成片。

rows.en: today i will show you three simple tricks that save about two hours of editing time
rows.zh: 今天我会演示三个简单的小技巧，能省下大约两个小时的剪辑时间。

rows.en: first always cut on the beat because rhythm is what keeps the audience awake
rows.zh: 第一，永远在节拍上剪，因为节奏才能让观众保持清醒。

rows.en: second remove the silent gaps longer than half a second before you touch the colors
rows.zh: 第二，在碰调色之前，先把长度超过半秒的静音空隙去掉。

rows.en: third normalize the audio to minus sixteen lufs which is the standard for online video platforms
rows.zh: 第三，把音频响度归一到负十六 LUFS，这是在线视频平台的标准。

rows.en: finally export at fifteen megabits per second and never trust the first render
rows.zh: 最后，以每秒十五兆的码率导出，而且永远不要相信第一次渲染。

rows.en: that is it for this episode see you in the next one
rows.zh: 本期就到这里，我们下期见。
